encounter.notes: Ornate bone/ivory Dwemer-style construct sharing Saint Llothis's base mesh and pose; paler near-white tint and a flatter fan-shaped helm crest instead of Llothis's tall point.

side_plates.note: No true left/right profile is published. No profile was synthesized; fabricated detail is not permitted.

registration.note: Listed before the torso plate so the torso wins in the overlap; the engine has no region gate for non-head closeups.

closeups.rejected_reason: MISREGISTERED despite a 2.82% width error - greaves and boots doubled in the overlay. Same failure as Llothis view-11; the rear-leg silhouette is near translation-invariant down its length so the row offset is under-determined.
head-region fit 11.16% at scale 0.533 - pinned to the search lower bound by the seed-scale bug (closeup has no shoulders in frame). Overlay shows the helm oversized and offset, rings doubled.
rear helm plate; view-06 equivalent already failed, not verifiable

geometry.provenance: Tencent Hunyuan3D-2mv (hunyuan3d-dit-v2-mv, fp16, 50 steps, octree 380, seed 12345) from view-01/view-03 only. Draft: 397,374 faces, 59.6s on an RTX 4070 Ti Super.

regions.note: Shoulder detector returned 0.7843 (front) / 0.8064 (back), verified visually: the line sits at the pauldron top with the helm and halo inside the head band. 0.78 used for both.

uv_density.note: Tuned for this silhouette: the crested helm plus halo ring is a far larger share of the body than a normal head, so it needs much LESS boost than Vrol (5.5) or Yandir (8.0). head_scale 5.5 overshot to 321^2 with the head taking 38.5% of the atlas; 2.0 lands ~258^2 at ~25%.

rights: The Elder Scrolls Online name, character design and related rights remain with ZeniMax Media/Bethesda Softworks. Reconstructed from published screenshots for an authorized fan prototype; not a claim that the IP is freely licensed.
